subject: Re: LumenHealth: Q3 inference demo — need to shift due to budget calendar
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Tannen <sara.tannen@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: LumenHealth: Q3 inference demo — scheduling

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo focused on predictable inference throughput and cost controls for your clinical-document pipeline.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Aug 19, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Aug 20, 14:00–14:45
- Thu Aug 21, 09:00–09:45

Sean (AE) and Rishi (solutions) will run the session — we'll cover live perf metrics, batching/caching options, and a short Q&A for your procurement questions.

Let me know which slot fits your team's calendar or if you want to propose alternate times.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: agenda-one-pager.txt]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: LumenHealth: Q3 inference demo — scheduling

Sean / Rishi — FYI, Sara asked for the demo. I have a travel conflict the week of Aug 19 (onsite at a partner) and won't be available for those proposed times. If they pick Aug 19/20/21 we should decide whether Sean runs the session solo or we shift.

Two notes:
- Lumen's CFO check-in is around the end of the month; Sara mentioned they might have a short spend freeze tied to a FY reset. Could mean they prefer demo after their budget clears (end-Aug to early-Sep).
- Procurement may want an SOW draft and the SLA/Qsheet beforehand — I pushed to attach a short agenda and a sample SOW.

If they need the earlier slots, Sean can lead and I can join remotely from the road for the Q&A. Rishi, can you confirm you can run the quick perf portion if Sean leads?

Monica

Onward: forwarding original request below.
From: Sara Tannen <sara.tannen@lumenhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kevin Miller <kmiller@lumenhealth.com>, LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-13T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumenHealth: Q3 inference demo — scheduling

Hi Monica — thanks for reaching out and for the proposed windows.

Two things on our end:
1) We've got a short internal spend freeze as part of our FY reset; finance will not sign new engagements or greenlight pilots until their review completes (expected week of Aug 25). That means we prefer to move any vendor-facing demos to after Aug 26 so procurement can be present and we're not scheduling demos that have to be paused.

2) Kevin (cc'd) leads the procurement review — Kevin, if you have a target window post-review that works for procurement, could you propose?

If it's helpful, we can target the first half of the week of Sep 2 (Sep 2–4). Otherwise, late the week of Sep 8 also works. We still want the demo — just trying to align with budget clarity and procurement availability.

Thanks,
Sara Tannen
Director, Clinical Platforms
LumenHealth

Hi Sara / Kevin — thanks for the quick update and for looping procurement in. Totally understand the spend freeze timing — happy to shift the demo so your finance/procurement can be on the call.

Proposed post-freeze windows (all PDT):
- Tue Sep 2, 09:30–10:15
- Wed Sep 3, 11:00–11:45
- Thu Sep 4, 14:00–14:45

If those don't work, feel free to propose any times the week of Sep 8.

I attached a short demo agenda and a draft SOW to speed procurement review — quick stubs: deck-demo-agenda.pdf, sow-template.docx. If useful, Sean and I can walk procurement through the SOW in a separate 20-minute call prior to the demo.

HubSpot contact: HS-473829
DocuSign SOW template: https://docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456

Sean / Rishi — FYI I'm still traveling Aug 19 but will be available for any prep calls the week of Aug 25. If Kevin/procurement confirm Sep 2–4 I'll calendar the demo and send a calendar invite with a short tech-check 15 minutes before the session.

Thanks,
Monica Patel

Redwood Inference
